source_doc: course/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/26_Fire Alarm System MCQ test Fire Alarm System Questions & Answers Safety Quiz Fir.md

points.K2: 最基础的报警：人工启动
points.K3: 自动报警把信号送出去

shots.scene: 欣欣站在红色手动报警按钮旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands next to a red manual fire alarm call point and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 火灾报警系统十问，一起来测！

shots.scene: 一行图标：报警按钮、探测器、喷头、水管接口
shots.prompt_en: A row of icons: a manual call point, a smoke detector, a sprinkler head and a hose inlet. No people.
shots.narration: 报警、探测、喷水，都在题里。

shots.scene: 大楼走廊天花板上的探测器和喷头
shots.prompt_en: Smoke detectors and sprinkler heads on a building corridor ceiling. No people.
shots.narration: 大楼里到处都有报警和喷水设施。

shots.scene: 老李带阿杰沿走廊看设施，拿着空白答题卡
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer walks the young male student along the corridor, both holding blank answer cards.
shots.narration: 老李带阿杰边看边答十道题。

shots.scene: 阿杰在答题卡上打勾
shots.prompt_en: The young male student ticks a blank answer card.
shots.narration: 每题四个选项，先选一个。

shots.scene: 答案表和计分图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank answer grid next to a score icon. No people.
shots.narration: 答案在最后，对照算分。

shots.section_title: 最基础的报警：人工启动
shots.scene: 手动报警按钮
shots.prompt_en: A manual fire alarm call point on a wall. No people.
shots.narration: 第一题：保护场所的报警系统是？
overlay: 最基础的报警：人工启动

shots.section_title: 最基础的报警：人工启动
shots.scene: 四张选项卡片
shots.prompt_en: Four blank option cards with icons: a simple bell, a hand pressing a button, two cards together and a bank building. No people.
shots.narration: 最基础、人工启动、A和B、只用于银行。

shots.section_title: 最基础的报警：人工启动
shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案C，A和B。

shots.section_title: 自动报警把信号送出去
shots.scene: 报警信号从大楼发出
shots.prompt_en: An alarm signal travels out from a building. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：自动报警系统是怎样的？
overlay: 自动报警把信号送出去

shots.section_title: 自动报警把信号送出去
shots.scene: 专线、电话线、光缆、无线图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of dedicated wires, a phone line, a fiber optic cable and a wireless antenna. No people.
shots.narration: 用专线、电话线、光缆或无线送出信号。

shots.section_title: 自动报警把信号送出去
shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案A，通过线路或无线把信号送出。

shots.scene: 三种探测器图标
shots.prompt_en: Three detector icons: a heat detector, a rate-of-rise detector and a smoke detector. No people.
shots.narration: 第三题：自动报警触发装置的基本类型？

shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案D，以上都是。

shots.scene: 感烟探测器剖面
shots.prompt_en: A cross-section of a smoke detector. No people.
shots.narration: 第四题：感烟探测器的两种基本类型？

shots.scene: 四组选项卡
shots.prompt_en: Four option cards pairing detector icons. No people.
shots.narration: 离子和差温、离子和光电、光电和差温……

shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案B，离子型和光电型。

shots.scene: 一堆冒烟不起火的阴燃物
shots.prompt_en: A pile of material smoldering with smoke but no flame. No people.
shots.narration: 第五题：光电感烟探测器的特点？

shots.scene: 四张选项卡片
shots.prompt_en: Four option cards with smoke and flame icons. No people.
shots.narration: 对阴燃更灵、较不灵、一样、明火更快。

shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案A，对阴燃火更敏感。

shots.scene: 一团明火
shots.prompt_en: An open flame burning brightly. No people.
shots.narration: 第六题：离子感烟探测器的特点？

shots.scene: 四张选项卡片
shots.prompt_en: Four option cards with smoke and flame icons. No people.
shots.narration: 阴燃更灵、阴燃同光电、明火更快、明火同光电。

shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案C，对明火反应更快。

shots.scene: 天花板喷头向下洒水
shots.prompt_en: A ceiling sprinkler head sprays water down. No people.
shots.narration: 第七题：自动喷水对人员安全的价值？

shots.scene: 楼层、水滴、烟雾三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: upper floors with people, water drops on a flame and a reduced smoke cloud. No people.
shots.narration: 楼上人员更易生还、直接洒水、限制燃烧产物。

shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案D，以上都是。

shots.scene: 建筑外墙上的消防车接口
shots.prompt_en: A fire department connection on the outside wall of a building. No people.
shots.narration: 第八题：消防车接口是怎样的？

shots.scene: 接口特写和四张选项卡
shots.prompt_en: A close-up of a double inlet with flappers, next to four option cards. No people.
shots.narration: 2.5英寸母口双接口带拍门，或大口径进水口。

shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案D，A和C。

shots.scene: 喷淋管道里水在流动
shots.prompt_en: Water flows through a sprinkler pipe. No people.
shots.narration: 第九题：水流报警是什么？

shots.scene: 四张选项卡片
shots.prompt_en: Four option cards with icons: a pipe with water, a building exterior bell, a dry pipe and a ceiling sprinkler. No people.
shots.narration: 指示水流问题、建筑外靠近接口、无水流……

shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案B，设在建筑外，靠近喷淋接口。

shots.scene: 干式阀，上方气压表、下方水压表
shots.prompt_en: A dry pipe valve with an air pressure gauge above the clapper and a water gauge below. No people.
shots.narration: 第十题：干式阀上方的气压表读数？

shots.scene: 两个压力表对比
shots.prompt_en: Two pressure gauges side by side, the upper one reading much lower. No people.
shots.narration: 和水压一样，还是明显低于水压？

shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案B，明显低于下方的水压。

shots.scene: 欣欣在白板前，白板上一张答案表
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a whiteboard with a blank answer grid.
shots.narration: 来对答案：一到五题。

shots.scene: 答案表下半部分亮起
shots.prompt_en: The lower half of the answer grid lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 六到十题。

shots.scene: 探测器和喷头图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of smoke detectors and a sprinkler head. No people.
shots.narration: 光电感烟阴燃灵，离子感烟明火快。

shots.scene: 阿杰对照答案数着勾
shots.prompt_en: The young male student compares his card with the grid and counts the ticks.
shots.narration: 对一对，看看自己得了几分。

shots.scene: 欣欣在报警按钮旁挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye next to the manual call point.
shots.narration: 火灾报警十问到这里，下次见！
